implementation.explicit_backend_contract: Runtime adapter v3 and observation v2 require backend, storage location, manifest_id, and timezone-aware as_of. Only legacy_jsonl_v1 and segmented_hot_v1 are accepted; there is no default or storage-path auto-detection.
implementation.single_hot_state: Each segmented adapter invocation calls load_segmented_v2_universe_state exactly once, passes that same validated state to both the persisted SEC materialization graph validator and shared membership resolver, and accepts only the current hot-tip manifest.
implementation.no_fallback: The segmented route does not call exact-generation recovery, traverse superseded lineage, or fall back to legacy after missing or corrupt hot records. Unknown backends fail before envelope or storage access.
implementation.identity_contract: Adapter and observation identities bind the explicit backend plus storage capability, checkpoint, tail, and tip-manifest hashes while excluding absolute paths and consumer labels. The legacy and segmented routes retain the same membership semantic snapshot.
implementation.shared_resolver: The legacy path reader and segmented state reader now feed one membership projection core, avoiding a second ledger load while preserving manifest/as-of, PIT, state, order, population, research-only, and default-off validation.
implementation.observation_handoff: Daily and replay remain true aliases and forward the explicit backend contract through one adapter call. The observation revalidates backend/hot-state identity and stable machine errors, but does not invoke Engine-0 or establish a market decision clock.
implementation.stable_damage_boundary: Non-string backend identities and non-string segmented storage capability markers now fail with stable V2 errors instead of leaking Python TypeError or KeyError.
implementation.compatibility_boundary: The required signature is an intentional pre-Engine-0 API break. Repository-wide Python call-site review found no unmigrated consumer outside the definitions, observation handoff, and updated tests.
